A low-quality '''cantina''' was once visited by a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] including the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Isila Drutch]]. The cantina has a poster of a female stormtrooper in femtrooper gear.
